title.en: PERSA TUAN BULAN SABIT MERAH NEGARA BRUNEI DARUSSALAM INCORPORATION ACT

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-159-1999-ED-PERSA-TUAN-BULAN-SABIT-MERAH-NEGARA-BRUNEI-DARUSSALAM-INCORPORATION-ACT.pdf》（6 页），本次切分 12 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Act may be cited as the Persatuan Sabit Negara Brunei Darussalam (Incorporation) Act.

In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires - tion means the Council referred to in section 6 ; the body incorporated the name Persatuan Sabit Merah Negara Darussalam by section 3 ; "Red the known as the British Red Cross Society Darussalam dissolved by subsection (1) of

who immediately before the commencement of this Act were members of the Red Cross Society, together with all such persons as may hereafter become members of the Persatuan pursuant to the rules and by-laws made under or referred to in section 9, shall be a body corporate by the name of the Persatuan Sabit Merah Negara Brunei and by such name shall have perpetual succession and a common seal; may enter into contracts; may acquire, lease, take, hold and enjoy property and convey, assign, surrender and yield up, charge, mortgage, re-assign or otherwise dispose of, or deal with any of the Persatuan upon such terms as it may consider and by such name may sue and be sued; and Bulan Sabit M erah may do all other things incidental or appertaining to a body

The objects of the Persatuan are to provide an organiopen, without any discrimination on the grounds of or politics, to all persons in Brunei Darussalam them to give effect to the purposes of the Persatuan, and to do all such other things as it may consider incidental or conducive to the attainment of such objects and purposes.

of the Persatuan are -

(a) in time of peace and war to carry on the work, and to furnish voluntary aid, in accordance with the and convenants of(i) the Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick Forces in the Field;

(ii) the Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded, Sick and Members of Armed Forces at Sea; (Hi) the Convention relative to the Treatment of War; and

(iv) the Convention relative to the Protection Prisoners in Time of War, all signed at Geneva on 12th August, 1949 and of I and II thereto signed on 10th June, 1977; and

(b) to perform all the duties devolving upon such a society by a nation has acceded to those Conventions.

The affairs of the Persatuan shall be administered by a ~ established in accordance with the rules and by-laws Persatuan : that the first members of the Council shall be persons who immediately before the commencement of this Act were the members of the Committee of the Red Cross

and other documents requiring the seal of the shall be sealed with its common seal pursuant to a of the Council to that effect, in the presence of the or a vice-chairman of the Council and of its secretary or some other person so authorised by the Council, who shall both sign every such deed or document, and such signing shall be sufficient evidence that it was duly and properly sealed and that it was the lawful seal.

(1) The Council shall cause a register to be kept in shall be recorded the name of every person who was, before the commencement of this Act, a member of the Red Cross Society or who may thereafter become a of the Persatuan, and in which shall also be recorded such other matters as may be determined by the Council.

(2) The register may be kept in such number of parts as the Council may decide.

The Council may make such rules and by-laws as it may expedient for the management of the affairs of the and for the attainment of its objects and purposes, and may amend the same; and all such rules and by-laws shall upon the members of the Persatuan : that the rules and by-laws of the Society in force at the commencement of this Act shall, until revoked or this section, have effect as the rules and I of the Persatuan as if they had been made under this

(1) All income and property of the Persatuan be applied solely towards the attainment objects and and no part thereof shall be paid or transferred or indirectly by way of dividend, bonus or otherwise to its members or any of them: that nothing in this subsection shall prevent the payment in good faith of remuneration to any officer or or to any member of the Persatuan in return for any services actually rendered to it by him,

(2) The liability of each member of the Persatuan in of its activities shall not exceed the amount of such subscription as may be due from him,

(1) On the commencement of this Act, the Red Cross Society is dissolved and all property vested in or belonging to of it, whether held in its name or in the name of any person in for it, is transferred to and without further assurance vest in the Persatuan for the respective estates and interests for which it was then held, and shall, together with all properties, subscriptions, contributions, donafines, loans and advances be held by the Persatuan for purposes,

(2) All debts and liabilities of the Red Cross Society immediately before the commencement of this Act by the Persatuan and all monies then due to the Red Cross Society shall be paid to the Persatuan,

(2) in this section applies to a trade mark before the commencement of this Act was registered in Brunei Darussalam and which consists of or contains any such words or design as is mentioned in subsection (1) ; and where a person is charged with using any such emblem, or design for any purpose and it is proved that he used them otherwise that as or as part of a trade mark so registered it shall be a defence for him to prove(a) that before the commencement of this Act he has lawfully used such emblem, words or design for that purpose in Brunei Darussalam; or

(b) in a case where he is charged with using such words or design upon goods, that the same had been applied to the goods before he acquired them other person who had manufactured or dealt with them, and that such other person had lawfully used the same in Brunei Darussalam upon similar before the commencement of this Act.

(3) who contravenes this section isguilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $5,000.00,imprisonment for one year or both, and any goods upon or in connection with which the emblem, words or design were used forfeited.

(4) When an offence under this Act committed by a body corporate is proved to have been committed with the or connivance of any director, manager, secretary or officer of the body corporate, he, as well as the body is guilty of the offence and liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly.

(5) Proceedings under this Act shall not be instituted the consent of the Attorney General.
